question: What was the actual growth rate of the seventh five year plan of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**6%**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Seventh Five Year Plan(1985-90)

 
 
• ​A​ims - Extending the green revolution to new areas.
 
• Target 5% growth rate and achieved **6 %.**

• Jawahar Rojgar Yojna
